notes.title: Devlog #10 - Video Essay, Environment Changes, Artstyle Rework Announcement, etc
notes.notes:
Heyoooo, another day, another devlog.

[b]THE VIDEO![/b]

This time, I got a video for ya. If you got an hour to spare, I discuss [i][b]WE'RE GETTING DEEPER INTO THE ABYSS [/b][/i]near the end of the video, even showing off a new character design from 2018. But I plan on putting them in the game, fun fun. It talks about the games I worked on over the years and me as an artist, I didn't get too deep into this game, but it does have some details in the game and what the gameplay will be about. But if you're following this game consistently, then hey. You may already know!

I feel video form is better! I suck at explaining since my ADHD lets me yap and I feel I may be rude sometimes when I don't mean to be, haha. I just suck at talking to others. Anyway, let's get into this one.

[previewyoutube=RRUlZBdMz0A;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]LOTTA NEW STUFF. AND I MEAN A LOT. ENVIRONMENT STUFF![/b]

So, okay. I've been working on trees, grass, and adding a lot of those over the time. It's been kinda... Repetitive to say the least. But this is something that makes the world look more nicer. I don't want to have the same single tree placed and same single grass model placed constantly. So, this is what I'm working on.

What happened to the buildings I was working on? Don't worry! These are being worked on constantly. I figured I need to make the world look nicer, and to do that, foliage was a focus. The foliage are painted in Substance painter, or Krita.

[b]- Trees = Substance Painter
- Grass = Substance Painter
- Leaf Textures = Krita
[/b]

The cool thing about the grass too, it has collision! So when the player steps on them, it squishes! Kinda cool, just a small detail.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44789794/0c3f631db4d603fc261b85e44c2452706a189a60.gif[/img]

Also, when you get too close to a certain object, like a tree for an example it has an effect to where it'll disappear / fade away. This is just something that's common in games now, or sometimes it won't in games? I've seen the camera in games just have collision and bump against walls and get closer to the player, this game won't have issues with the camera, so don't worry about fighting the camera.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44789794/d95465ee05759cd10576025c41bfa8bd865da976.gif[/img]

[b]Regarding NFTS... I say NO to them for my projects. [/b]

I would also like to say, I received an email talking about selling my art (characters of this game, models, etc) and just to clarify. [b]I WILL NEVER EVER SELL NFTs OF THIS GAME OR MY CHARACTERS! [/b]So, if you ever see anything of my character or anything that says the developer agrees of this, so uhh.. Me? No. I don't. I will release ART of my characters that you can download and use as anything you'd like, profile photos, desktop backgrounds, phone backgrounds, anything. Just DON'T fall for any scams related to my small game if you see any.

I'm a small creator, so uh. Highly doubt anything is going to happen, but still. It worries me, yeah? Just would like to spread the word!

[b]REDESIGN OF THE ART STYLE. EVENTUALLY...[/b]

So uh, I've been thinking of working on the art style eventually. This is a major change, but not too major, you're seeing the same gameplay, but the main character will be changing sprites and animations. I feel I can make a better drawing of him overall. I feel it could just be better. I made him when I didn't know anything about digital art and now I know a bit of it. So, I may experiment with some art styles and come back to the public with some ideas. But the world will stay the same. Maybe, no promises. I tend to change my mind a lot, haha.


[b]Think that's it?[/b]

I've mostly just been messing around with modeling still and I know it's been quiet, that video was something I worked on and honestly, I don't think it's a big devlog, but it shows you my history as a developer. But hey! Hopefully it's still interesting. I'll share more as time comes along. 

When time comes to share more, I tend to update more in the Discord server, so please join there. Also, I plan on streaming my game development sometimes, so check me out there if you'd like. Only really plan on streaming the game development process and that's really it. Rarely will I do anything else because I'm not really a variety streamer. I made this channel to directly stream game development and that's it. Answer questions and.. Yeah, that's it, too.

notes.title: Devlog #4 - Graphical Update, New Screenshots URP Pipeline,
notes.notes:
Heyo, let's see what changed.

So, a lot has happened behind the scenes these past few weeks. I'd like to show you.

I decided to make some new graphical changes. But why? Mostly because I just felt like things were outdated already. There were FPS drops in the models since I used Sketchup 3D. [i]Used.[/i]Now, I use Maya. Also, I remodeled everything and created my own grass textures, anything you see that is a stock asset, I plan on changing. So please, no worries. I plan on using my own assets, no worries.

I remade the ENTIRE game from what I had already. This was pretty quick. Y'know, the time going and all. Let me show you the progress. I remade the entire main menu. Let me show you main menu before.

 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44789794/ed75e83a8fea3559b86657b4944d173ef6f15a0e.png[/img]

While it wasn't bad a few months ago to me, I look at it now and think it's pretty bad. It isn't bad to most people either, The FPS in this was pretty bad. Like, terrible. The models would have to be redone to fix that issue, so. I did redo it. In another program, I just said screw it, and redid it. While the menu was also in theme, it gave too much away for the story in the beginning. I'd like the players to go in surprised. Believe me, this game has a lot of silly stuff, and serious stuff.

Anyway, here is this NEW menu.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44789794/5a80dc98b2ec6662d284dcd3d8c6775ebd566ccd.png[/img]

There is now a logo, interactive text that when hovered over, animation will play, and options that are very universal. The options will only get better, no worries. Here is an example of the option menu. This isn't fully done, so please be aware. Well, the programming is done. But the UI isn't.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44789794/f3e68e1763f4abc7c13ba32ba9e9c897b322d3b8.png[/img]

More options soon.

There are presets, and people must wonder what these presets do, so I put an option to read them. This also isn't done when it comes to visibility. So, take a look. This will be updated in the future.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44789794/26558b039dd043985ed72fae585131298b31c312.png[/img]

This is how it will look. But UI will be changed when it comes to sprites, animations will play. Everything works! The menu is fully animated and looks better than the original. The original menu did have stuff done, just didn't look as clean. Now this does. It also has a fully fleshed logo. I will be updating this Steam a bit more soon.

And to update this steam, this game now runs on the URP pipeline, as I believe the HDRP pipeline is a great pipeline, but it limits me to future planning. If I ever wanted to port this game to the Switch, for example, or the earlier consoles, it would be extremely hard to. As the HDRP pipeline is something that makes frame rate tank. So, I'm switching to the URP pipeline to make this stuff a little easier on everyone. Woohoo.

I think that's really it, though. Here is a few more screenshots. I'm getting there in development for big stuff. I just decided to remake this stuff since it didn't satisfy me, if it didn't satisfy me then it wouldn't for most players. Furthermore, I'll be updating a lot of things in this game. The sprites, UI, you name it. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44789794/34f03877cc40ce68de7014d1b7b916ec4d46ce3e.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44789794/3a069c98e3e5950419d7ac16d585355308232ff7.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44789794/b2b713d2a9911f2bd398a4c2615ca1fe6664dfb8.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44789794/d449e9a0d8c810b968c0a01638d525ad865d115b.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44789794/f750925293cb159c157fefd48a5843e1a47b7b64.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44789794/51873a808dd60e41bd0d385d42a2d7b50edcafa2.png[/img]

Still workin' on stuff, will definitely change this lighting, remember, this is just the beginning of the game, there is a WHOLE town to explore, and the post-processing will constantly change. It just depends on what area you're in. Gonna be great.
